notes.title: What happened to Negative Type?
notes.notes:
As with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/770120/Yoltrund/]Yoltrund[/url], Negative Type had spent time in a release sinkhole. So, what exactly is going on? 

Let's get a few things out of the way; us (Templarius) are not developing the game, and the game is pretty much finished. The fault is on us; not the developer. 

If that's the case, why is the game not released? Because we encountered issues in releasing the game. There are a few issues and some functionality that needs to be added over time, however, as with Yoltrund, we are stuck in a release cycle with Valve where we simply can't get approval to release. It's been a lot of "he said, she said" with us in the middle relaying messages. 

At this point, the developer has moved on to another project while we try and get this one out there for you to enjoy. We are deeply sorry for the hiatus and hope to get Negative Type released soon. We enjoyed the game and want you to enjoy it too. 

Sincerely,
[i]Mark Reardon[/i]
PR Lead.
